headline: Home Environment, from entry to detail
overview: Assess rooms and spaces for satisfaction, issues, and needed improvements. Understand how your living environment impacts your wellbeing and identify areas for positive change.
targetAudience: Users interested in wellbeing tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Home Environment — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the room assessment interface where you can evaluate each space in your home.
steps.screenshotAlt: Home Environment landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Assess satisfaction levels for each room and space in your home
Log issues and needed improvements per space
Track changes in your home environment over time
Understand the connection between your living space and wellbeing
tips: Walk through each room mindfully before rating — notice how the space makes you feel physically and emotionally.
Revisit your assessment after making improvements to track the impact on your overall satisfaction.
note: Imported from Inner Quest's app-owned walkthrough library. The captures are real product evidence, but their original run manifest and detailed interaction log predate Walkthrough Studio, so freshness is not claimed.
